aboutText: Anantha Lakshmi Institute of Technology and Sciences (ALITS), established in 2008 by the visionary Anantha Lakshmi Educational Society under the dynamic stewardship of Sri M. Anantha Ramudu (Founder & Chairman), stands as a beacon of academic excellence in the Rayalaseema region.

Spanning over 54 acres of serene, lush-green campus along the Ananthapur - Chennai Highway, ALITS is an Autonomous Institution accredited with NAAC 'A' Grade and NBA accreditation for core engineering programs. ALITS offers 9 specialized engineering & diploma disciplines, nurturing over 5,800 students with state-of-the-art innovation labs, skill development directorate, digital libraries, and 100% placement support.

notices.title: Autonomous End-Semester Theory & Practical Exam Schedule Released
notices.author: Controller of Examinations (CoE)
notices.content: JNTUA Autonomous End-Semester Regular & Supplementary examinations for III B.Tech I Semester (R23/R20) will commence from 05-Oct-2026. Hall tickets are now available for digital download in the Student & Parent mobile app. Students with fee clearances can download directly.

notices.title: Campus Recruitment Drive: TCS Ninja & Digital for IV Year B.Tech
notices.author: Training & Placement Cell
notices.content: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) invites applications for Ninja (3.6 LPA) and Digital (7.2 LPA) roles. All eligible students from CSE, AIML, ECE & EEE with minimum 65% aggregate and zero active backlogs must submit their application on the portal before 15-Sep-2026.

notices.title: Anantha Tech Fest 2026: National Level Technical Symposium
notices.author: ALITS Student Affairs
notices.content: Annual National Level Symposium 'ANANTHA TECH FEST 2026' featuring Paper Presentations, Coding Hackathons, Robo-Wars, and Project Expos is scheduled for 24-25 Sep 2026. Win cash prizes worth ₹1,50,000! Register with your department coordinator.

notices.title: Parents-Teachers Interactive Meet (PTM) for III B.Tech Students
notices.author: Dean Academics & HoDs
notices.content: All parents and guardians of III B.Tech students are cordially invited for the Parent-Teacher Meet on Saturday, 12-Sep-2026 at 10:00 AM at the ALITS Auditorium to discuss student academic progress, CIE Mid marks, and placement readiness.

notices.title: Autonomous Academic Regulations & Condonation Guidelines
notices.author: Principal's Office
notices.content: Students are strictly reminded that a minimum of 75% attendance is mandatory to appear for autonomous end-semester examinations. Condonation is strictly limited between 65% - 75% on genuine medical grounds with prior approval.

assignments.title: RESTful Microservices Architecture with Flask & SQLite
assignments.instructions: Implement a full REST API with role-based JWT/token auth, SQLite database migrations, and real-time SSE stream for automated updates. Submit project GitHub link and 5-page PDF report.

assignments.title: Convolutional Neural Network Implementation on MNIST Dataset
assignments.facultyFeedback: Excellent model accuracy (98.4%) and clean visualization graphs.
assignments.instructions: Train a 4-layer CNN in PyTorch/TensorFlow, evaluate confusion matrix, precision, recall, and plot training loss curves.

assignments.title: Autonomous College ERP Schema Normalization Case Study
assignments.instructions: Design 3NF and BCNF normalized ER schema for college roster, fee installments, internal marks, and transport bus routes. Include DDL SQL statements.

assignments.title: Dynamic Programming & Greedy Algorithms Problem Set
assignments.instructions: Solve 0/1 Knapsack, Longest Common Subsequence, and Dijkstra's Single Source Shortest Path with complete time-space complexity proof.

assignments.title: TCP Congestion Control & Socket Programming in Python
assignments.instructions: Build client-server chat architecture using BSD sockets with AES-256 encrypted payload transmission.
